comment: Each rendering was regenerated from the current PaperInterface declaration and retains visible parameters, premises, relational PAV selector, canonical STV initial state, legal transition domain, terminal condition, and both results.

paper_lemma_c1_pav_selector_eq_unique_in.tex_statement: For a natural district magnitude M and a real party share y with 0<y\le1, there exist a natural seat count n and an integer ell such that n is a leftmost maximizer of the finite PAV score for (y,M), n=ell after the natural-to-integer coercion, y(M+1)-1\le ell<y(M+1), every integer satisfying that half-open interval equals ell, and every leftmost PAV maximizer has integer value ell.

paper_proposition1_all_ballot_routed_sur.tex_statement: Let P,Q,A be finite voter rosters, R,S,I finite candidate rosters, b a ballot profile, M,V natural numbers, y a real share, and pi a lawful ballot-routed STV transfer policy.  Assume decidable equality for the finite carriers, 0<y\le1, M(M+1)\le V, M\le|R| and M\le|S|, complete within-party-before-opponent rankings, V=|A|, A=P\cup Q with disjoint parties, disjoint candidate rosters R,S, R\subseteq I, S\subseteq I, I\subseteq R\cup S, yV=|P|, and (1-y)V=|Q|.  Then for every terminal state t reached by the reflexive-transitive closure of the legal STV transition from the internally constructed unit-weight state on A and I, and for every natural n that is a relational leftmost PAV maximizer for (y,M), both the Republican STV final-seat count in t and n lie in the adjacent floor/ceiling rounded-seat set for yM.
